sentences.en: Your opinion is off the mark. That's plain to anyone.
sentences.zh: 你的意见偏离了主题。这任何人都看得出来。

sentences.en: He tried harder to get good marks than I did.
sentences.zh: 他比我还努力地争取好成绩。

sentences.en: Ike doesn't seem to be up to the mark today.
sentences.zh: 艾克今天似乎不在状态。
